page.overview:
Who is Bordon's wife?

This female Human was the wife of Bordon and mother of Tallo and Wend. She fought for the Army of Light during the Ruusan campaign and was killed in battle by the Brotherhood of Darkness during the Fourth Battle of Ruusan.
